name: Ulfhednar
subtitle: Wolf Warrior
description: Escalate your attacks with Critical and Strong strikes as you destroy your foes HP and Defense
lore: Feared even among berserkers, the ulfhednar—the wolf-skinned—are some of the world’s fiercest warriors. While myths of shapeshifting among them are exaggerations, some supernatural element really has seeped into the ulfhednar since the Shattering. They seem driven by a unified purpose beyond their battlefield objectives, as though they truly are a single pack led by some unseen and unknown leader.
divinity_generator: Gain [30] Divinity when inflicting damage to an enemy.

skills.name: Vicious Cleave
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy. Strong and Critical Hits destroy 3% of the target’s Max HP. Also, has a 20% additional chance to Critical Hit.

skills.name: Warband
skills.description: Critical Hits against the same enemy inflict 20% increased damage.

skills.description: Attack all enemies 2 times and ignore [mechanic:shield] and [mechanic:barrier]. Also, has a 20% additional chance to Critical Hit.

skills.name: Odin's Hunters
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 3 times. The first attack has a 50% chance to apply [mechanic:def-down-i] on the target for 2 turns. If the enemy is under [DEF Down], attacks have a 20% additional chance to Critical Hit.
